DIAGNOSIS READY: Auriculotemporal Neuralgia (post-tympanoplasty) secondary to auricular chondritis.

The shooting pain triggered by eating and the inability to wear earrings strongly suggest inflammation of the auricular cartilage irritating the auriculotemporal nerve, rather than a simple graft failure. I am confident in this diagnosis based on the specific nature of your symptoms and your history of chronic ear infections.
